halt_flags.description: VENDOR_FP_LIST is keyed by canonical_name only ('Harris', 'Axon', 'Flock Safety', 'Genetec'), but the caller (db.validation.phase3_inference_candidates.sar8_match + db.validation.sar8_bulk_stage._classify) invokes vendor_match_disposition(candidate, alias_string) iterating over ALL alias-strings in the §2.1 lexicon (not just canonical_names). When the alias_string passed in is something like 'Harris Corporation' (an alias of 'Harris'), the FP-list lookup VENDOR_FP_LIST.get('Harris Corporation') returns [] — so the FP-substring check ('harris adacom' in candidate_lower) never fires. Default match then accepts via prefix-token ('harris adacom corporation'.startswith('harris ') = True).
halt_flags.proposed_fix: (a) Restructure caller to invoke vendor_match_disposition(candidate, canonical_name) once per canonical (not once per alias-string), then separately test each alias-string for canonical-equivalence via a dedicated alias-equality predicate. The caller's loop becomes: for each canonical entry → FP check (single canonical lookup) → alias-allowlist check → default match against canonical AND each alias-string. (b) Alternatively, restructure VENDOR_FP_LIST so that any alias-string of the canonical also resolves to the same FP entries via a forward-lookup map.
halt_flags.ceo_ratification_ask: Approve fix (a) caller-restructure? Once fixed, the 2 Harris Adacom rows correctly reject_fp on the next bulk-stage pass.
